sources.note: Dell OptiPlex 7010 technical specifications (opened, text read; this is the 2012 generation): Small Form Factor 11.4 x 3.7 x 12.3 in (H x W x D) = 29.0 x 9.3 x 31.2 cm, ports 1 RJ-45, 2 line-in, 2 line-out (headphone/speaker). Used as the form-factor reference only. The current 7010 SFF is quoted at 290 x 92.6 x 292.8 mm by Dell (read in a search-result summary of Dell's tech-spec page, the page itself was not opened); the 292.8 mm depth is used.

Dell OptiPlex 7010 SFF shop page (opened): the specs section did not load, so it gave no dimensions or port layout. Nothing on this page was used for a number.  PORT POSITIONS (all three, confidence 'guess' since 2026-11-10): invented for a stand-in small-form-factor PC, plausible places on its rear plate (RJ-45 left of centre, audio jack top left, power inlet right).
